title: Customer portal and field-service app
summary: Northwind manages maintenance contracts for 140 commercial buildings. Jobs are scheduled in spreadsheets, engineers report by WhatsApp, and clients phone the office to ask for updates. You told us the goal is one system where clients see the status of their jobs, engineers log work from their phones, and the office stops re-typing.
This proposal covers a web portal for your clients and office team, a mobile app for engineers, and the API that connects them, delivered in four milestones over ten weeks.
goals: Clients can see every open and completed job for their buildings without calling the office
Engineers log attendance, photos and parts from their phone, online or offline
The office schedules jobs in one place and exports monthly reports per client
A foundation your team can extend: documented API, tests, and a staging environment
deliverables: Job list and detail per building, status timeline, photos, PDF job reports, user accounts with roles for client, office and admin.
Job scheduling calendar, engineer assignment, contract and SLA tracking, monthly report export (CSV and PDF).
Today's jobs, check-in and check-out, photo capture, parts used, signature, offline queue that syncs when back online.
Django REST API with PostgreSQL, role-based permissions, audit log, email notifications on job status changes.
AWS hosting with staging and production, CI pipeline, monitoring, written documentation and a two-hour handover session.
outOfScope: Native payment collection or invoicing (can be scoped as a follow-on)
Migration of historic jobs older than 12 months
Custom branding per client beyond logo and colours
phases: Workshops with the office team, data model, clickable prototype of the portal and app screens, written spec signed off before build.
API, database, authentication, client portal and office dashboard on staging for weekly review.
React Native app with offline sync, TestFlight and Play internal testing builds for your engineers to trial on real jobs.
Data import, App Store and Play submission, production deployment, documentation and training.
milestones: Milestone 1: Discovery, design and signed-off spec
Milestone 2: Portal, dashboard and API on staging
included: A dedicated team and named project lead end to end, with written updates every week
Automated tests, code review and a staging environment
30 days of bug fixes after launch at no charge
Full source code and documentation, owned by you on final payment
optional: Invoicing and card payments in the client portal
terms: The first milestone is invoiced on signing and starts the project. Each later milestone is invoiced on delivery and due within 7 days, by bank transfer or card.
Changes outside the agreed scope are estimated in writing before any work begins.
You own all source code, designs and data on payment of the final milestone. We keep the right to show the work in our portfolio unless agreed otherwise.
Third-party costs (hosting, app store accounts, SMS or email services) are paid directly by you.
This proposal is valid until the date on the cover. Timeline starts on receipt of the first milestone payment and the materials listed in the next steps.

Send access to your current spreadsheets and a sample client contract
